# NOTE: maintenance notes live HERE, in YAML comments -- pandoc passes <!-- -->
# straight through to the published page, so a body comment ends up in public
# page source.
#
# The empty ::: {#refs} ::: div below is load-bearing. Without it, citeproc
# appends the bibliography at the END of the document, which would drop the
# whole list below the Software section. The div pins it in place.
#
# The list deliberately has NO heading above it. "References" was wrong -- these
# are Adam's own publications, not works cited -- and any heading there stacks a
# second header directly under the page title. Software is the only h2.
#
# The two Software entries are hand-written rather than @software records in
# references.bib, because nocite: '@*' sweeps EVERY bib entry into the list
# above -- a bib entry would appear in both sections. They are formatted to
# match int-res.csl output: Authors (Year) Title. Source. Deliberately no
# version number: the Zenodo DOIs are concept DOIs that track the current
# release, so a pinned version here would go stale on each release.
---
